phases.name: Learn
phases.milestone: Complete a stakeholder map and present back what you've learned to your manager.

phases.name: Contribute
phases.milestone: Ship one visible improvement to an existing surface and run your first feature kickoff.

phases.name: Lead
phases.milestone: Present a 6-month roadmap for your area to leadership and unblock a strategic initiative.

goals.title: Map and have 1:1s with all 8 key stakeholders by Day 21
Audit the current product analytics setup and identify 3 measurement gaps
Document a clear understanding of the company's current GTM and ICP
Ship a small, visible quality-of-life improvement chosen with engineering
Run your first feature kickoff with a written one-pager and clear success criteria
Establish a weekly product sync rhythm with engineering and design
Present a 6-month roadmap with prioritisation tradeoffs to leadership
Drive a cross-functional initiative end-to-end (kickoff, launch, retro)

successDefinition: By Day 90, I'm trusted as the owner of my product surface. Engineering and design pull me into decisions early. Leadership uses my roadmap to plan headcount. I've shipped at least one thing customers asked for.

firstWeekActivities.title: 1:1 with manager — set expectations, ramp plan, success criteria
Read the latest product strategy doc and write a 1-pager of takeaways
Shadow a sales call to hear how customers describe the product
Set up weekly recurring 1:1s with engineering and design leads
Audit the top 5 dashboards in your analytics tool
